items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: There was Miss Teenie, Mr. Mack, and there was the children, Laura, Laura Vessel and Mack Jr.

ctx.x: When you look, you know, in your neighborhood, who, do you remember who your neighbors were on either side and, like, across the street? Do you remember the name? I don't know.

Or the... Let me see. Going way back, when we were living back on Scott Street, Reverend Ivy was the neighbor on one side, I can remember. And there was this lady who was living with my uncle, and he recently died. I'm talking about my uncle Bill. That's my mama's brother. Uh-huh. And it was a lady he was living with. I can't remember who the lady was he was living with. But that was on Scott Street. Now, on... When we move up by my grandmother, next door to our house was the Owl Club, that big place on the…
We all friendly with us, the people.
